verses.en: The word that came to Jeremiah from the LORD in the tenth year of Zedekiah king of Judah, which was the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar.
verses.sm: Alii O le afioga na oo mai ia Ieremia mai le ALII i le sefulu o tausaga o Setekaia le tupu o Iuta, o le sefulu ma le valu lea o tausaga o Nepukanesa.

verses.en: For then the king of Babylon's army besieged Jerusalem: and Jeremiah the prophet was shut up in the court of the prison, which was in the king of Judah's house.
verses.sm: O ona po ia na vagaia ai Ierusalema e le itu taua a le tupu o Papelonia; sa puipuia foi Ieremia le perofeta i le lotoa o le fale puipui sa i le fale o le tupu o Iuta.

verses.en: For Zedekiah king of Judah had shut him up, saying, Wherefore dost thou prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall take it;
verses.sm: Aua na puipuia o ia e Setekaia le tupu o Iuta, ua ia faapea, Se a ea le mea ua e vavalo ai, ua faapea mai, O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, Faauta, ou te tuuina atu lenei aai i le lima o le tupu o Papelonia, na te aea;

verses.en: And Zedekiah king of Judah shall not escape out of the hand of the Chaldeans, but shall surely be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon, and shall speak with him mouth to mouth, and his eyes shall behold his eyes;
verses.sm: e le sao foi Setekaia le tupu o Iuta ai lima o Kaletaia, a e tuuina lava o ia i le lima o le tupu o Papelonia, Ia te tautala faafesaga'i ma ia, ma la feiloaʻi ma ia;

verses.en: And he shall lead Zedekiah to Babylon, and there shall he be until I visit him, saith the LORD: though ye fight with the Chaldeans, ye shall not prosper.
verses.sm: e taʻitaʻiina foi e ia o Setekaia i Papelonia, e i ai foi o ia i lea mea seia ou asiasi atu ia te ia, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII; e ui lava ina outou tau ma Kaletaia e le manuia outou.

verses.en: And Jeremiah said, The word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Ieremia, Ua oo mai le afioga a le ALII ia te au, ua faapea mai.

verses.en: Behold, Hanameel the son of Shallum thine uncle shall come unto thee, saying, Buy thee my field that is in Anathoth: for the right of redemption is thine to buy it.
verses.sm: Faauta, e sau ia te oe o Hanameali, le atalii o Saluma, o le uso o lou tama, e faapea mai, Ia e faatau mo oe loʻu fanua o loo i Anatota; aua ua ia te oe le pule i le faatau e faatau ai.

verses.en: So Hanameel mine uncle's son came to me in the court of the prison according to the word of the LORD, and said unto me, Buy my field, I pray thee, that is in Anathoth, which is in the country of Benjamin: for the right of inheritance is thine, and the redemption is thine; buy it for thyself. Then I knew that this was the word of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ona sau ai lea ia te au i le lotoa o le fale puipui o Hanameali, le atalii o le uso o loʻu tama, e pei o le afioga a le ALII, ua faapea mai ia te au, Seʻi e faatau loʻu fanua, o loo i Anatota o i le nuu o Peniamina ; aua e au le pule e fai mou le fanua, e ou foi le faatau; ina faatau ia mo oe. Ona ou iloa ai lea, o le afioga a le ALII lea.

verses.en: And I bought the field of Hanameel my uncle's son, that was in Anathoth, and weighed him the money, even seventeen shekels of silver.
verses.sm: ọ Ona ou faatauina lea mai ia Hanameali, le atalii o le uso o loʻu tama, o le fanua o loo i Anatota, ma ou fuatia ia te ia o tupe, o sekeli ario e sefulu ma le fitu.

verses.en: And I subscribed the evidence, and sealed it, and took witnesses, and weighed him the money in the balances.
verses.sm: Ona ou tusia lea i le tusi, ma ou faamaufaailogaina ai, ma ou amia mai molimau, ma ou fuatia le ario i le fua faatautau.

verses.en: So I took the evidence of the purchase, both that which was sealed according to the law and custom, and that which was open:
verses.sm: Ona ou ave ai lea o le tusi o le faatau, o le ua faamaufaailogaina e tusa ma le poloaiga ma tulafono, atoa ma le ua le faamauina;

verses.en: And I gave the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, the son of Maaseiah, in the sight of Hanameel mine uncle's son, and in the presence of the witnesses that subscribed the book of the purchase, before all the Jews that sat in the court of the prison.
verses.sm: ua ou ave foi le tusi o le faatau ia Paruka, le atalii O Neria, le atalii o Maaseia, luma o Hanameali, le atalii o le uso o loʻu tama, i luma foi o molimau na tusi i le tusi o le faatau, i luma foi o tagata luta uma sa nonofo i le lotoa o le fale puipui.

verses.en: And I charged Baruch before them, saying,
verses.sm: Ua ou matua fai atu foi ia Paruka i o latou luma, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Take these evidences, this evidence of the purchase, both which is sealed, and this evidence which is open; and put them in an earthen vessel, that they may continue many days.
verses.sm: O loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o “au, le Atua o Isaraelu, Ia e ave nei tusi, o lenei lava tusi o le faatau, o le ua faamaufaailogaina, atoa foi ma lenei tusi ua le faamauina, ia e tuu ai foi i se ipu omea, ina ia tumau i aso e tele;

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD of hosts, the God of Israel; Houses and fields and vineyards shall be possessed again in this land.
verses.sm: aua o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII o ‘au, le Atua o Isaraelu, E toe faatauina i le nuu nei o fale, ma fanua, ma tovine.

verses.en: Now when I had delivered the evidence of the purchase unto Baruch the son of Neriah, I prayed unto the LORD, saying,
verses.sm: Ua ou tuuina le tusi o le faatau ia Paruka le atalii o Neria, imulimuli ane ona ou tatalo atu lea i le ALII, ua faapea atu,

verses.en: Ah Lord GOD! behold, thou hast made the heaven and the earth by thy great power and stretched out arm, and there is nothing too hard for thee:
verses.sm: Aue! le ALII e le ATUA, faauta, o oe na e faia le lagi ma le lalolagi i lou inalosi tele, ma lou aao faaloaloa, e le faigata foi ia te oe se mea e tasi;

verses.en: Thou shewest lovingkindness unto thousands, and recompensest the iniquity of the fathers into the bosom of their children after them: the Great, the Mighty God, the LORD of hosts, is his name,
verses.sm: ua e alofa i afe o tupulaga, ua e taui atu foi le amioletonu a rama i fatafata o a latou fanau pe a mavae atu i latou; o le Atua sili, ma le malosi, o le ALII o “au, o lona suafa lea,

verses.en: Great in counsel, and mighty in work: for thine eyes are open upon all the ways of the sons of men: to give every one according to his ways, and according to the fruit of his doings:
verses.sm: e sili i faautauta, e silisili foi i au mea e fai; aua ua silasila ou fofoga i ala uma o tagata; e tuuina atu i tagata taitasi e tusa ma Ona ala, e tusa foi ma le fua o ana amioga;

verses.en: Which hast set signs and wonders in the land of Egypt, even unto this day, and in Israel, and among other men; and hast made thee a name, as at this day;
verses.sm: o le na faatuina foi o faailoga ma vavega i le nuu o Aikupito, ua 00 i le aso nei, ma le nuu o Isaraelu, atoa ma nuu o tagata ese; ua e faia foi mo oe le suafa, e pei ona faia i le aso nei.

verses.en: And hast brought forth thy people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, and with wonders, and with a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with great terror;
verses.sm: Na e aumaia foi lou nuu o Isaraelu mai le nuu o Aikupito, ma faailoga, ma vavega, ma le aao malosi, ma le aao faaloaloa, ma mea matua matautia.

verses.en: And hast given them this land, which thou didst swear to their fathers to give them, a land flowing with milk and honey;
verses.sm: Ua e foaiina mai foi ia te i latou lenei nuu, na e tauto ai i o latou tama e foai ia te i latou, o le nuu o tafe ai le suasusu ma le meli;

verses.en: And they came in, and possessed it; but they obeyed not thy voice, neither walked in thy law; they have done nothing of all that thou commandedst them to do: therefore thou hast caused all this evil to come upon them:
verses.sm: na latou o mai ai, ma fai ai mo latou; a ua latou le faalogo i lou siufofoga, ma latou le savavali e tusa ma au tulafono; ua latou le faia mea uma na e poloai ai ia te i latou ia faia; o le mea lea ua e faaoo ai nei mea leaga uma ia te i latou.

verses.en: Behold the mounts, they are come unto the city to take it; and the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans, that fight against it, because of the sword, and of the famine, and of the pestilence: and what thou hast spoken is come to pass; and, behold, thou seest it.
verses.sm: Faauta mai, o mea mautietie, ua 00 mai lava i le aai e aea ai; ua tuuina foi le aai i lima o Kaletaia o e ua faasaga tau mai ai, aua o le pelu, ma le oge, ma le faamai; o le mea lava na e fetalaia ua 00; faauta mai foi, ua e silafia.

verses.en: And thou hast said unto me, O Lord GOD, Buy thee the field for money, and take witnesses; for the city is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.sm: A o oe, le ALII e le ATUA, ua e fetalai mai ia te au, Ia e faatau le fanua mo oe i tupe, ma aami atu molimau; a o le aai, ua tuuina atu lea i lima o Kaletaia.

verses.en: Then came the word of the LORD unto Jeremiah, saying,
verses.sm: Ona oo mai ai lea o le afioga a le ALII: ia Jeremia, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Behold, I am the LORD, the God of all flesh: is there any thing too hard for me?
verses.sm: Faauta, o a'u lava o le ALII, o le Atua o tagata uma; pe faigata ea ia te au se mea e tasi?

verses.en: Therefore thus saith the LORD; Behold, I will give this city into the hand of the Chaldeans, and into the hand of Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon, and he shall take it:
verses.sm: O lea o loo faapea ona fetalai mai ai o le ALII, Faauta, ou te tuuina atu lenei aai i lima o Kaletaia, ma le lima o Nepukanesa le tupu o Papelonia, e aea ai foi e ia;

verses.en: And the Chaldeans, that fight against this city, shall come and set fire on this city, and burn it with the houses, upon whose roofs they have offered incense unto Baal, and poured out drink offerings unto other gods, to provoke me to anger.
verses.sm: e o mai foi Kaletaia, o E tau ma lenei aai, ma latou faamu lenei aai i le au, e susunuina ai lava e i latou, atoa ma fale na faamuina ai mea manogi i o latou luga ia Paala, ma latou liligi ifo ai taulaga i mea e inu i atua ese, ina ia latou faaonoono mai ia te au.

verses.en: For the children of Israel and the children of Judah have only done evil before me from their youth: for the children of Israel have only provoked me to anger with the work of their hands, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: Aua ua na o mea leaga ua faia i oʻu luma e le fanauga a Isaraelu ma le fanauga a Iuta talu ina o taulelea i latou; aua ua na ona faaonoono mai o le fanauga a Isaraelu ia te au i galuega a o latou lima, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.

verses.en: For this city hath been to me as a provocation of mine anger and of my fury from the day that they built it even unto this day; that I should remove it from before my face,
verses.sm: Aua ua faia lenei aai ia te au ma mea ou te tiga ai, ma mea ou te ita ai, talu mai le aso na faia ai, ua oo lava i le aso nei, ina ia ou aveeseina ai i oʻu luma;

verses.en: Because of all the evil of the children of Israel and of the children of Judah, which they have done to provoke me to anger, they, their kings, their princes, their priests, and their prophets, and the men of Judah, and the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.sm: ona o amio leaga uma a le fanauga a Isaraelu, ma le fanauga a Iuta, ua latou faia e faaonoono ai ia te au, o i latou, o latou tupu, o latou alii, o latou faitaulaga, ma o latou perofeta, ma tagata Iuta, atoa ma e o nonofo i Ierusalema.

verses.en: And they have turned unto me the back, and not the face: though I taught them, rising up early and teaching them, yet they have not hearkened to receive instruction.
verses.sm: Ua u mai ia te au o latou tua, a e le o latou mata; ua ou aʻoaʻo atu ia te i latou, ua ou ala aʻoaʻo atu ai lava, a ua latou le faalogo lava ina ia talia mea ua aʻoaʻoina atu ai;

verses.en: But they set their abominations in the house, which is called by my name, to defile it.
verses.sm: a ua latou tuuina a latou mea e inosia i le fale ua taʻua ai loʻu igoa, ina ia latou faaleagaina ai.

verses.en: And they built the high places of Baal, which are in the valley of the son of Hinnom, to cause their sons and their daughters to pass through the fire unto Molech; which I commanded them not, neither came it into my mind, that they should do this abomination, to cause Judah to sin.
verses.sm: Ua faia foi e i latou mea maualuluga ia Paala, ua i le vanu o le atalii o Hinoma, ina ia latou faaui ane o latou atalii ma o latou afafine i le afi ia Moloka; o le mea lava ou te lei poloai ai ia te i latou, ou te lei manatu foi i ai; ua faia e i latou lenei mea e inosia e faatupuina ai le agasala ia Iuta.

verses.en: And now therefore thus saith the LORD, the God of Israel, concerning this city, whereof ye say, It shall be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence;
verses.sm: A o lenei, o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, le Atua o Isaraelu, i le aai nei, o loo ua outou fai mai ai, Ua tuuina atu ia i le lima o le tupu o Papelonia i le pelu, ma le oge, ma le faamai ;

verses.en: Behold, I will gather them out of all countries, whither I have driven them in mine anger, and in my fury, and in great wrath; and I will bring them again unto this place, and I will cause them to dwell safely:
verses.sm: faauta, ou te faapotopoto ia te i latou ai nuu uma ua ou tulia ai i latou i loʻu tiga, ma loʻu ita, ma le ita tele; ou te faafoisia mai i latou i lenei mea, ma ou faanonofoina ai i latou ma le filemu;

verses.en: And they shall be my people, and I will be their God:
verses.sm: e fai foi i latou moʻu nuu, e fai foi afu mo latou Atua.

verses.en: And I will give them one heart, and one way, that they may fear me for ever, for the good of them, and of their children after them:
verses.sm: Ou te foaiina atu ia te i latou le loto e tasi, ma le ala e tasi, ina ia latou matatau ia te au i aso uma lava, ia lelei ai i latou, atoa foi ma a latou fanau pe a mavae atu i latou;

verses.en: And I will make an everlasting covenant with them, that I will not turn away from them, to do them good; but I will put my fear in their hearts, that they shall not depart from me.
verses.sm: ou te osia foi le feagaiga e faavavau ma i latou, ou te le liliu ese ai ia te i latou, a ou te agalelei atu ia te i latou; ou te tuuina atu foi le mataʻu ia te au i o latou loto, ina ia latou le liliu ese ia te au.

verses.en: Yea, I will rejoice over them to do them good, and I will plant them in this land assuredly with my whole heart and with my whole soul.
verses.sm: Ou te fiafia lava ia te i latou, ma ou agalelei atu ia te i latou, ma ou totoina i latou i lenei nuu ma le faamaoni, ma loʻu loto atoa, ma loʻu agaga atoa.

verses.en: For thus saith the LORD; Like as I have brought all this great evil upon this people, so will I bring upon them all the good that I have promised them.
verses.sm: Aua o loo faapea ona fetalai mai o le ALII, E pei ona ou faaoo i lenei nuu lenei malaia tele uma, e faapea foi ọna ou fagoo ia te i latou Je manuia uma ua ou folafolaina ia te i latou.

verses.en: And fields shall be bought in this land, whereof ye say, It is desolate without man or beast; it is given into the hand of the Chaldeans.
verses.sm: E faataulia foi fanua i le nuu nei, ua outou faapea mai ai, Ua faatafunaina ia, e le o i ai se tagata, po o se manu; ua tuuina atu ia i lima o Kaletaia.

verses.en: Men shall buy fields for money, and subscribe evidences, and seal them, and take witnesses in the land of Benjamin, and in the places about Jerusalem, and in the cities of Judah, and in the cities of the mountains, and in the cities of the valley, and in the cities of the south: for I will cause their captivity to return, saith the LORD.
verses.sm: E faataulia e i latou fanua i rupe, ma latou tusia ai i tusi, ma faamaufaailogaina al, ma aami molimau i le nuu o Peniamina, ma mea e vagavagai i Ierusalema, ma aai o Iuta, ma aai i atu mauga, ma aai i le itu maulalo, ma aai i le itn i toga; aua ou te faafoisia lava lo latou tafeaga, ua fetalai mai ai le ALII.
